text:
Marta: Heads-up — FinSolve reported that their April invoice omitted the interoperability fee line (interop fee) and shows a doubled reserved discount. Invoice ID inv_2024_04_9982. Can someone look?

Ken: Ugh. I see a duplicate invoice record for acct: FS-442 in our billing DB too. Looks like two submissions processed within 2s.

BillingBot: automated: invoice-gen job completed for acct FS-442, inv_2024_04_9982 (status: success)

Priya: Do we have logs for the job run IDs? can we pull the payloads?

Sam: I pulled the job traces. One run shows line_items: ["compute", "reserved_discount", "support"], the other run contains ["compute", "interop_fee", "reserved_discount"]. The merged output omitted interop_fee and applied reserved_discount twice.

Marta: That sounds like a merge/race during aggregation. Customer is upset — they were charged ~$1.2k less for interop fee and discount is doubled (~$700 extra credit). They want a corrected PDF and a credit memo asap.

Ken: Repro steps: found duplicate webhook events from usage-collector (two identical batch events with same batch_id) at 2024-04-30T03:12:11Z and 03:12:13Z. billing-ingest retried both and our dedupe key failed because batch_id was null in one payload.

Priya: Filing a ticket to ENG: replay + enforce non-null dedupe key on ingest. tagging @eng-billing.

Ken: For immediate fix we can: 1) void the duplicated invoice and reissue corrected invoice; 2) send a credit memo for the missing interop fee if reissue won't be fast enough. Which does finance prefer?

Marta: Reissue preferred if it won't take >48h. If >48h, issue an interim credit memo. Also need note for FinSolve explaining root cause & ETA.

Sam: I've re-run the invoice assembly locally with de-duped events and the resulting invoice includes the interop_fee and shows reserved_discount once. Sample excerpt:
```
line_items:
 - compute: $4,120.00
 - interop_fee: $1,200.00
 - reserved_discount: -$600.00
 - support: $150.00
total: $4,870.00
```

Ken: I'll void inv_2024_04_9982 and create inv_2024_04_9982_v2 with corrected lines. Will also create credit memo CM_9982_interim for the customer for the net if we need to.

BillingBot: automated: void request submitted for inv_2024_04_9982 by Ken at 2024-05-02T11:25:00Z

Priya: ENG ticket opened: ENG-5478. Summary: billing-ingest accepts duplicate batch when batch_id null -> double discount + missing interop_fee. Request: require batch_id, reject duplicates, backfill affected invoices (list attached).

Marta: Thanks. Ken, please add a short apology + root cause in the reissue cover note. Also include the credit memo if we moved forward with interim.

Ken: Will do. ETA for reissue: 6 hours. Will ping here when done. :thumbsup:

Marta: Please also cc accounts-payable contact at FinSolve (ap@finsolve.com). They want both PDF and ledger CSV.

Ken: Noted. Follow-up: reissued inv_2024_04_9982_v2 (status: sent) and attached credit memo CM_9982_interim (status: issued). Sent to ap@finsolve.com.

BillingBot: automated: dispatch email to ap@finsolve.com for inv_2024_04_9982_v2 and CM_9982_interim at 2024-05-02T17:42:10Z

FinSolve (note forwarded by Marta): "Thanks — received reissue and credit. Please confirm root cause fix timeline."

Priya: ENG response: patch in code review, rollout to prod planned in next deploy window (tomorrow morning).

Marta: OK great. Closing loop once prod deploy is green and we have backfill list completed.

Ken: Closing: mark as resolved in Jira once ENG deploy and we confirm no other affected invoices.

Sam: FYI I added an alert to billing-ingest that counts null batch_id occurrences. Threshold: 1 per hour -> page on spike.

Marta: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer note and share for review. :heart:
